eric.desc1: Forever English Corner was founded by

eric.desc3: . Even during the challenging COVID-19 pandemic, Uncle Eric never suspended these events—demonstrating unwavering commitment to the community. It was during this period that
eric.desc4: joined the gatherings for the first time!

tony.title: Tony - The Organizer & Builder
tony.desc1: Due to Uncle Eric's busy schedule,
tony.desc2: now takes charge of organizing our gatherings. Tony is a seasoned software engineer with extensive experience in the gaming and financial sectors. He built this website to make it easier for everyone to join us, and is currently developing a sophisticated financial website for investors. With Tony's tech expertise and passion, we're bringing Forever English Corner into the digital age! 🚀

daniel.title: Daniel - The Mystery Organizer
daniel.desc: We'd love to tell you more about **Daniel**, who ran our gatherings before Tony joined! However, Tony has never met him in person, so we don't have much information to share. **If you know Daniel or have stories about him, we'd be thrilled to hear from you!** Your insights would help us complete this part of our community's history. Reach out through our chat or WeChat!

alternatives.note: 💡 We'll have you meeting our requirements in no time! Feel free to ask our AI assistant for tips on improving your English skills.
